svg.title: JGDMS five-host topology — Host 5 dedicated JFR telemetry service
svg.desc: Five-host topology. Host 1 is the Jini lookup service. Host 2 is the SELinux bytecode analysis engine. Host 3 is the VerdictRegistry. Host 4 is the codebase downloader and pipeline orchestrator, proactive, triggered by ServiceRegistrar events from Host 1. Host 5 is the new JFR telemetry service, reactive, receives jdk.VirtualThreadPinned events from any number of client hosts via JERI, deduplicates and rate-limits, correlates content hash, and submits reanalysis requests to Host 2 via BAE proxy, then submits updated signed reports to Host 3 via VerdictRegistry proxy. Host 4 and Host 5 share no direct connection — they communicate independently with Host 2 and Host 3. Clients report JFR events to Host 5 and perform verdict lookups directly against Host 3.
svg.text: foreign service providers — untrusted, any OS
JERI · authenticated · marshalled service item + codebase URL

g.text: stores marshalled service items opaquely · does NOT unmarshal proxies · fires ServiceRegistrar events
opaque store · fires events on registration
no BAE proxy · no registry proxy · no URL fetching
Host 4 — codebase downloader service (any OS) — proactive
triggered by lookup registration events · only component with outbound internet · no connection to Host 5
